report_name: Ransomware Attacks Hit 2026 High in July, NCC Group Reports

threat_actors.name: The Gentlemen
threat_actors.description: A prominent ransomware group identified by NCC Group as being highly active in July 2026, claiming responsibility for 15% of all recorded attacks.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware and data exfiltration.

threat_actors.name: CRPxO
threat_actors.description: A new ransomware group that emerged in July 2026, claiming 36 victims. NCC Group advises treating claims from new groups with caution as they may be exaggerated.
threat_actors.goals: Financial extortion through ransomware and data exfiltration.

attack_patterns.name: Data Encrypted for Impact
attack_patterns.description: The core activity of ransomware groups, involving the encryption of victim data to disrupt operations and extort payment.

attack_patterns.name: Inhibit System Recovery
attack_patterns.description: A common ransomware technique mentioned in the report, specifically the deletion of volume shadow copies to prevent easy recovery from backups.

attack_patterns.name: Disable or Modify Tools
attack_patterns.description: A common ransomware TTP involving the disabling of security tools to evade detection, which the report advises organizations to monitor for.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Attackers steal data and threaten to leak it publicly as part of double-extortion tactics, which the report notes has become standard practice.

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Identified as a primary initial access vector for ransomware groups, which can be mitigated by prompt patch management.

attack_patterns.name: Phishing
attack_patterns.description: Remains a common entry point for ransomware attacks, which can be mitigated through employee training.

attack_patterns.name: Lateral Tool Transfer
attack_patterns.description: Ransomware groups use tools like Cobalt Strike and Brute Ratel to move laterally within victim networks.

malware.name: JADEPUFFER
malware.description: An AI-driven agent speculated by NCC Group to have the potential to automate and scale future ransomware attacks.

tools.name: Cobalt Strike
tools.description: Mentioned as a tool used for lateral movement by ransomware groups, which organizations should monitor for.

tools.name: Brute Ratel
tools.description: Mentioned as a tool used for lateral movement by ransomware groups, which organizations should monitor for.

identities.name: Industrials Sector
identities.description: The most heavily targeted industry sector in July 2026, accounting for 28% of all ransomware attacks. This includes manufacturing, engineering, and construction firms.

indicators.name: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via VSSAdmin
indicators.pattern:
title: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via VSSAdmin
id: 9b8a1b3c-7e5f-4d2a-8c1d-9e0f1a2b3c4d
status: experimental
description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common technique used by ransomware to inhibit system recovery.
references:
  - https://www.nccgroup.com/newsroom/ncc-group-monthly-threat-pulse-review-of-july-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-26
tags:
  - attack.t1490
  - attack.impact
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'delete'
      - 'shadows'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate administrative activity, though rare.
level: high
indicators.description: Detects the use of vssadmin.exe to delete volume shadow copies, a common ransomware TTP mentioned in the report.

indicators.name: Windows Defender Disabled via PowerShell
indicators.pattern:
title: Windows Defender Disabled via PowerShell
id: 1a2b3c4d-5e6f-4a7b-8c9d-0e1f2a3b4c5d
status: experimental
description: Detects attempts to disable Windows Defender's real-time monitoring via PowerShell, a common defense evasion technique used by malware.
references:
  - https://www.nccgroup.com/newsroom/ncc-group-monthly-threat-pulse-review-of-july-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-26
tags:
  - attack.t1562.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: 
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'Set-MpPreference -DisableRealtimeMonitoring $true'
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Legitimate scripts used by administrators or developers to temporarily disable AV for performance reasons.
level: high
indicators.description: Detects the disabling of Windows Defender, a specific example of the 'disabling of security tools' TTP mentioned in the report.

relationships.source_name: Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via VSSAdmin
